title: Marie Fowler went back to the classroom and came out with a doctorate

posts.facebook:
Marie Fowler hadn't been in a classroom since 1959. At 83 she became Howard University's oldest doctoral graduate.

Marie Fowler, 83, completed a Doctor of Ministry at Howard University in three years, becoming its oldest doctoral graduate in May 2024 — more than six decades after she was last in school.

Commit to one semester; the doubt about whether your brain still works is answered by showing up.
